name: דַּמֶּשֶׂק
summary: Damascus is the city that Isaiah calls the head of Aram; Genesis locates Hobah north of it. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: מִשְּׂמֹאל לְדַמָּשֶׂק locates Hobah north of Damascus.
Isaiah calls Damascus the head of Aram and Rezin the head of Damascus.

note: Moved from the former word entry `ddammaecaeq` (old root key דמשׂק).
